shortDescription: China’s recent overhaul of how homes are sold will worsen already stretched local government finances and drive a 30% drop in land sale revenues, Goldman Sachs Group Inc. economists said, according to Bloomberg.

title: Goldman Sees China Property Changes Cutting Land Sales 30%
